about: Sounds for Pour Decisions' first sound batch (board items 1, 5, 6, 9, 10, 12). generate_sounds.py makes each one with ElevenLabs sound effects. folder: amb = ambience loops (sounds/amb), loop = machine loops (sounds/loop), sfx = one-shot hits (sounds/sfx, replacing the made-up hit of the same name), step = footsteps (sounds/step).

sounds.name: morning
sounds.text: Early morning in a leafy Brisbane riverside suburb: rainbow lorikeets screeching in trees, magpies warbling, a butcherbird, distant light traffic, a soft breeze. No voices, no music.

sounds.name: dawn
sounds.text: Pre-dawn bird chorus in subtropical Brisbane: magpies carolling, butcherbird song, a kookaburra far off, very quiet distant traffic. No voices.

sounds.name: wind
sounds.text: Steady wind high up on an open construction deck, buffeting past steel scaffolding, mesh edge screens flapping a little. No voices.

sounds.name: rain
sounds.text: Steady light rain falling on plywood formwork, steel reinforcing bar and puddles on a construction site. No thunder, no voices.

sounds.name: truck_idle
sounds.text: Concrete agitator truck idling, big diesel engine ticking over while the mixing drum turns slowly and churns wet concrete. Close up, no voices.

sounds.name: truck_beeper
sounds.text: Classic truck reversing beeper: a clean pure-tone beep, beep, beep at a steady even rhythm, about one beep per second, outdoors on a building site, quiet diesel idle under it. No voices.

sounds.name: air_brake
sounds.text: Heavy truck air brake release, a short sharp hiss.

sounds.name: chute_rattle
sounds.text: Steel concrete truck chute swung down and clanking into place, metal rattle.

sounds.name: pump_engine
sounds.text: Trailer concrete pump diesel engine running hard under load, steady deep rumble with hydraulic whine, close up. No voices.

sounds.name: bang
sounds.text: A steel pipe clamp bursting under high pressure on a concrete pump line: a loud metallic bang then a spray hiss.

sounds.name: thunk
sounds.text: Heavy industrial emergency stop button slapped, a solid plastic and metal thunk.

sounds.name: boom_hydraulics
sounds.text: Hydraulic arm of a concrete pump truck moving slowly: smooth steady low hydraulic hum and gentle fluid whine at a constant level. No sudden peaks, no bangs, no clanks. No voices.

sounds.name: crane_slew
sounds.text: Tower crane slewing: electric motor hum and gear whir high overhead. No voices.

sounds.name: hoist
sounds.text: Construction site elevator car riding up the outside of a building: smooth steady low electric motor hum with a soft gear rumble, constant and even, outdoors. No clicks, no bangs. No voices.

sounds.name: mesh_1

sounds.name: wet_1

sounds.name: concrete_pour
sounds.text: Wet concrete pouring out of a pump hose onto a slab: thick heavy slapping and gloop, steady. No voices.

sounds.name: poker
sounds.text: Concrete vibrator poker running in wet concrete: petrol drive unit droning with a buzzing head, bubbling. No voices.

sounds.name: screed
sounds.text: Wet concrete being levelled by hand with a long aluminium straight edge: slow heavy wet sliding swish and slop of thick concrete, outdoors on a building site. No motor, no machinery, no buzzing tools. No voices.

sounds.name: shovel_scrape
sounds.text: A steel shovel scraping and scooping wet concrete, one scoop.

sounds.name: poker_glug
sounds.text: A concrete vibrator plunged into wet concrete, a deep glug and bubbles.

sounds.name: ding
sounds.text: A clean bright bell ding for a job done well, short and pleasant, game sound.

sounds.name: chime
sounds.text: A soft two-note rising chime, game reward sound, warm.

sounds.name: clank
sounds.text: A heavy steel pipe clamp snapped shut, short metallic clank.

sounds.name: clang
sounds.text: A steel pipe dropped onto concrete, a ringing clang.

sounds.name: tink
sounds.text: A tiny metal tink, a steel pin tapped with a hammer, short.

sounds.name: river
sounds.text: Brisbane River lapping against a riverside boardwalk and a floating ferry pontoon: gentle small waves slapping on concrete and timber, water sloshing under the pontoon, a light breeze, a few distant gulls. Calm and steady. No boats, no voices.

sounds.name: traffic
sounds.text: Busy suburban road heard from the footpath: a steady flow of cars passing both ways, tyres on asphalt, the occasional bus pulling away. No horns, no sirens, no voices.

sounds.name: park
sounds.text: Open parkland golf course in Brisbane in the morning: wide open space, magpies carolling, a kookaburra laughing in the distance, noisy miners chattering, a soft breeze in tall gum trees. No voices, no traffic.

sounds.name: city
sounds.text: High up on a rooftop above a city in the morning: a soft distant hum of traffic far below, a steady breeze, the odd faint far-off bird. Calm and spacious. No voices.

sounds.name: citycat
sounds.text: Fast catamaran river ferry cruising: steady muffled diesel engines and water jets humming, the wake rushing and hissing along the twin hulls, heard from the back deck. Steady. No horn, no voices.

sounds.name: whistle_short_1
sounds.text: One single short sharp blast on a metal pea whistle, blown hard by a crane signaller on a building site, outdoors. Just one blast, about a quarter of a second long, then silence.

sounds.name: whistle_long
